name: Latent-NeRF
definition: Applies score distillation to a latent diffusion model and the compact latent space of a pre-trained autoencoder to optimize NeRF.
summary: Latent-NeRF optimizes Neural Radiance Fields in a compact latent space using score distillation from a stable diffusion model, enabling high-quality novel view synthesis and text-guided editing without dense 3D supervision.
